title: The Incredible Thailand Deal | Yona Floating Club, Phi Phi Parties & Tiger Encounters
highlights: Experience the best of Thailand with luxe stays, thrilling wildlife encounters, floating beach clubs, island parties, and vibrant nightlife — all in one unforgettable tropical escape.
Come face-to-face with majestic tigers at Phuket’s renowned Tiger Kingdom — a once-in-a-lifetime encounter blending thrill, awe, and unforgettable memories.
Party in paradise at the exclusive Yona Floating Beach Club—Thailand’s only floating venue with poolside beats, amazing food vouchers, and Ibiza-style energy.
Set sail on an exclusive Pirate Boat Party during your stay in Phi Phi Island — where turquoise waters, live DJs, and golden sunsets create pure island magic.
Enjoy the perfect balance of luxury and comfort with stays in a private pool villa and a 5-star hotel—combining privacy, elegance, and tropical bliss.
overview:
About the Tour:
﻿Touch down in Phuket for the ultimate tropical adventure! Start strong with a private transfer straight from the airport to the Tiger Kingdom, where you’ll come face-to-face with majestic big cats—an adrenaline-pumping welcome to Thailand! Next, dive into Phuket’s luxe side with a Yona Floating Beach Club experience—Thailand’s most exclusive floating party, complete with DJs, pools, and hefty food vouchers for the perfect day under the sun. Sail to Phi Phi Islands for island-hopping bliss, free pool parties, and the iconic Pirate/Blanco Boat Party, reserved only for Phi Phi residents. End your trip in style at the Ramada Plaza Phuket, soaking in mountain views before exploring the electric nightlife of Bangla Road. From wild encounters to luxury lounging and ocean parties—this tour is Phuket’s finest mix of thrill, chill, and unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: International/ domestic flights are not included in the package price.
Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Please do not litter and keep destination clean
Images are for representation purposes only.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is advisable to carry enough cash while travelling. Please note that carrying a minimum 10,000 Baht in cash is mandatory while travelling to Thailand.
It is recommended that you carry travel essentials like sunscreen, hat, sunglasses, swimwear, etc.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket | Visit to Tiger Kingdom
days.desc: Welcome to the tropical paradise of Phuket! Upon arrival at the airport, board your transfer and get driven to the hotel. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax for a while. Later, get driven to the famous Tiger Kingdom, one of Phuket’s top attractions, where you’ll come face-to-face with the tigers under expert supervision. This unique experience offers a safe, guided interaction with big cats, allowing you to capture incredible photos and witness these powerful animals up close.

items.title: Check-in at Chalong Chalet Resort & Longstay
Tiger Kingdom Phuket Tickets - Big Tiger Ticket with Private Transfer

days.title: Yona Floating Beach Club Experience
days.desc: Today, get ready and board your transfer for Thailand’s most exclusive beach party at Yona Floating Beach Club. Once at the pier, set sail on a luxury floating venue surrounded by the Andaman Sea, and enjoy pool access and live DJ performances while soaking in the stunning ocean views. Use your food voucher to indulge in gourmet bites as you sip tropical drinks, lounge on sunbeds, and soak in the perfect blend of music, luxury, and island vibes. Later, get driven to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Phi Phi Island | Leisure & Pool Party
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to the pier and board a scenic ferry ride to the world-famous Phi Phi Islands. Upon arrival, check in to your island hotel and relax for a while. Then, spend the day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the pristine beaches, soaking in the stunning coastal views. For a lively evening, you can go snorkeling in crystal-clear waters or join the Ibiza-style pool party, where upbeat music, cocktails, and ocean views set the perfect tropical mood.

items.desc: 1 X Speed Boat will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Paradise Resort Phi Phi

days.title: Pirate Boat Party
days.desc: Today, get ready for an unforgettable adventure on the exclusive Pirate Boat Party, open only to Phi Phi Island guests. Cruise through emerald waters, dance to live DJ sets, and watch the sunset paint the Andaman sky in gold. With vibrant music, ocean breeze, and island energy, it’s the ultimate Phi Phi experience you’ll never forget. After an amazing day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Phi Phi Pirate Boat Tour - Exclusive Party - Only For Phi Phi Residents

days.title: Transfer to Phuket | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to Phuket. Upon arrival, check in to your luxurious 5-star hotel and relax for a while. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore the city on your own or step out to explore Bangla Road, the heart of Phuket’s nightlife, showcasing live performances with amazing experiences. Also, you can watch the Simon Cabaret Show, a world-famous performance featuring dazzling costumes and incredible stage acts.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out from your hotel. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing trip to Thailand!
